scripts.build:electron: pnpm --filter @ether/application build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && esbuild src/preload/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/preload/preload.cjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @ether/engine build && pnpm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ETHER_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ether/engine build && pnpm run build:electron && vite build
